posts.title: Biscuit, 9, and the 10-day switch
posts.excerpt: A 9-year-old beagle moved to Senior Gentle Dog Food over 10 days.
posts.content:
Biscuit is nine, a beagle with a grey muzzle who still treats every walk on the Leith waterfront as a scent trail. For most of his life he ate the same adult bag, and for most of his life it suited him.

Last spring Fiona Grant noticed he was slower on the hill and less keen at the bowl. She asked Priya Nair at the counter, who talked through his age and what the Thursday nutrition desk could add, and Fiona decided to try Senior Gentle Dog Food, turkey and pumpkin, 6 kg.

The switch took 10 days, the way we always suggest it: a quarter of the new food for days 1 to 3, half for days 4 to 6, three quarters for days 7 to 9, and the whole bowl on day 10. Fiona kept a note on the fridge so nobody miscounted.

This is what we saw, and only that: Biscuit finished every bowl through the switch, the stools stayed ordinary, and he was waiting at the door at 14:00 on the first day of the full bag. We make no claim beyond what a household notices in a fortnight, and anything medical belongs with the vet.

Biscuit is now on a 4-week subscription. The 6 kg bag is £36.00 one-off and £32.40 on subscribe and save, 10% off every repeat delivery, and Fiona can skip, change or cancel up to 48 hours before dispatch.

If you have a dog of a similar age, the finder takes three questions. If you would rather talk, Dr Amara Osei holds the free 20-minute desk on Thursdays from 15:00 to 19:00.
